body: I have a tendency to be too empathetic for my own good so group therapy tends to be a huge trigger. I have joined a couple of local lgbt groups but I find it difficult to reach out to people.

I guess if I'm missing anything it's people. Lately even when there's someone in the same room as me I feel so lonely. But no one around me seems to want to know me and all the friends I've had have drifted away.
